events.title: Essential Utilities Q1 Earnings Lag, Revenues Surpass Estimates
events.body: WTRG Q1 EPS misses estimates, but revenues jump to $862M and beat forecasts as merger approvals with American Water Works advance.

events.title: American States Water Q1 Earnings Miss Estimates, Sales Increase Y/Y
events.body: AWR Q1 operating EPS misses estimates by a penny, while total revenues climb 14% to $169.2 million on gains across all segments.

events.title: California Water Service Q1 Earnings Miss Estimates on Higher Costs
events.body: CWT's Q1 EPS is down to 7 cents and misses estimates as expenses and interest climbed; revenue rise 5.2% and a $218 million Nexus deal broadens reach.

events.title: California Water Service Group Q1 Earnings Call Highlights
